title: _index.json v1 — six machine-owned field groups
description: Written only by next_node (initialisation), node_commit and gate_answer (04 series doc 01 §5.2 v0.2). Groups: identity, path & cursor, gate, timing, evidence digest, terminal. Never accepts external input.

execution_loading_mode.description: Machine projection of the current executor, not a mode override. Lite retains loading_mode=lite and currently borrows normal. Optional for historical caches.

governance.description: alpha.22 E4: canonical v1.0 governance hash of the routed program vs the hash it declares; registration only.

target_aiap_dir.description: AIAP §23.6 (optional): absolute path written by generator pipelines.

updated_at.description: Last engine write of this index (set by every write); fallback anchor for transport-wait accounting (doc 06 §2).

name.description: Qualified id: bare name at depth 0, Parent/ns.Node for sub-graph nodes (any depth).

doc.description: Module document of a sub node (null = entry document).

node.description: Bare graph node name (null for engine nodes).

call_stack.description: Open module frames, innermost last (doc 05 §4.2). Empty at depth 0. Each frame is the sub-graph a module node opened; the sub nodes it executes are catalog entries with parent = frame.parent.

order.description: Sub nodes committed in this frame so far.

source.description: model_request: the model asked the user on a node that declares no gate source (doc 12 §7.4).

serves.description: How many times next-node served this occurrence (doc 14 D7): 1 = fresh; >1 = re_serve (the model asked again without committing - after a rejected commit, after --help, or after a host re-entry).

transport_wait_ms.description: Raw recorded recovery wait, including startup outside ready->commit. Only the measured-window interval union is deducted from active_elapsed_ms. Legacy caches without interval anchors retain their original total-only deduction.

transport_wait_intervals.description: Host-recorded recovery intervals for this occurrence; overlapping intervals are deducted once within ready->end only.

transport_wait_legacy_ms.description: Pre-Alpha34 total without recoverable anchors, preserved only when a legacy occurrence receives a new interval.

parent.description: Sub node: qualified id of the module node that opened its frame.

order.description: Sub node: commit order inside its frame (0-based).

dispatch.description: doc 10 §3.1: executor record of an outer occurrence. mode agent = dispatched to a sub-agent (ticket state machine); mode inline with a downgrade = declared agent but run inline (NORMAL_MODE_FORCES_INLINE / SPAWN_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED / EXECUTE_MODE_UNKNOWN).

human_replacement.description: docs/05SoulRun 84/87: the human's choice of one new child for a root whose child returned with an error (paused at an answered gate or not), or whose liveness an interruption left unknown; bound to that exact return or interrupted ticket.

handoff.description: Machine-checked returned segment and unstarted continuation; replacement is not same-child resume.

module.description: Module node: the sub-graph frame it opened (doc 05 §4.2/§4.3).

anomalies_by_code.description: docs/05SoulRun 87: run-index anomaly records (anomalies_summary) per code; a count, never a severity.

accounting.description: Machine accounting keys merged at Engine.execute-report (legacy Router.summary); values are scalars only, except the per-code anomaly counts.

final_answer_metrics.description: alpha.47 (doc 93): observability only - the delivered answer's size and composition (composed chars, the model's own lead, report_parts count, coverage rows); never a gate.

dispatch.description: doc 10 §3.1: run-level sub-agent dispatch accounting; policy is decided at Router.cache-setup from program.loading_mode.

independent_hard_limit.description: Default 16/20 plus machine-recorded, human-authorized run-local additions.

ordinary_resumes_claimed.description: Machine-confirmed same-child ordinary gate continuations; total claims remain in spawns_claimed.

independent_resumes_claimed.description: Native-authorized same-child independent continuations; independent_claimed remains raw.

status.description: Host projection (soulbot.engine_hooks._engine_functional_outcome): run_state in lower case. Derived on every write; never an input.

functional_execution_status.description: Host projection: semantics.functional_status when COMPLETED, FAIL when FAILED/ABANDONED, WAITING_USER, else UNVERIFIED.

failure_code.description: Host projection: termination kind as a code when the run ended without success.

host_tools.description: alpha.62 (doc 135 §4 B): host capabilities beyond the stream; agent=false means no Agent tool, so declared-agent nodes run inline (HOST_NO_AGENT_TOOL).

host.description: Facts the host reports (prepare_cache / finalize); never used by the engine to decide anything - except host_fences (alpha.44), which only widens the texts the model may stream, and host_tools (alpha.62), which only narrows dispatch to what the host can do.

hsaw_register.description: alpha.87 (doc 193 §5): the run's sovereignty doubt gate register - engine-written, append-only, sha-chained (seq, prev_sha, sha).

cancelled.description: alpha.88 (doc 196 F4'): set by gate_answer when the human cancelled at a business / sub node without a confirm_rejected route - the business work closed there, Engine.execute-report and Engine.final-answer still ran, the run ends COMPLETED with run_termination.kind cancelled. Absent in older caches.

contract_delivery.description: alpha.100 (04 series doc 241): the mixed contract delivery ledger - sessions (direct next-node calls), serves, the sections given in the current model session with the digest of their text and the serve they rode on, the --contract reads (last 200), the last served node's sections, counters. Engine-written. Absent in older caches.

catalog_history.description: Machine-owned accepted definitions; read provenance only, never a future plan.
